comment: Hand-maintained parameter types for tools/gen-natives.cs: native id -> parameter name -> "Type" or "Type newName", and "result": "bool" for a predicate (its doc says 1 or 0, a flag, a check) whose int result the shipped scripts use only as a condition (Common.PadIsPressedRaw and Btl.ActorPartnerReady nearly only; their few value uses read AsInt(...)). The types are the enums of src/Ffx.Atel.Game/Enums.g.cs (tools/gen-enums.cs), Map (Map.g.cs, tools/gen-maps.cs), Sfx and TextId (a message of the script's table, written Text[n]); "int:Battle" is an int whose values the constants of a static class name (Battle.g.cs), for a parameter or a result (Atel.Values). Sources: each native's doc (data/natives.json, from ffx-rust symbols/ffx.sym) names the argument (actor selector, property, command, motion, msg); the property ids are MsGetChrStatInfo's (ffx-rust docs/formats/battle.md). The "docs" section: per native a modder-facing "summary" (and optionally a verified "name", "rename" of parameters and "params" descriptions), written from what is verified (ffx-rust symbols/ffx.sym without its '?' guesses, the ported natives in ffx-rust crates/ffx-script/src/vm/bridge/, the Ghidra dump); the symbol's notes then go to <remarks>. tools/gen-natives.cs fails on names that mislead ("Ret").

0x600c.name: EyeAddHeightLimitSoft
0x600c.summary: Keeps the camera's eye between heights <paramref name="low"/> and <paramref name="high"/>, pulling it back softly. Returns 0. Was <c>EyeAddCircleArea</c>.
0x600c.notes: handler calls 0x007bb370 with side 1, kind 0. MsAtelCameraRefAddCircleArea_007bb370 (worker, _, stack, side, kind) pops c, b, a and calls MsCameraRefAddCircleArea_007bf1f0(cam, side, kind, a, b, c): one of the channel's five limits, +0x18 = low, +0x1c = high, +0xc = keep, kind 1 (kind 0) or 3 (else). ms_camera_limits (ffx-rust crates/ffx-battle/src/camera.rs) treats kinds 1 and 3 as limits on the side's height (position y): kind 1 pulls it back softly (atan), kind 3 keeps that share of the overshoot past them (y = low + (y - low) * keep above low, and alike below high). Was named a circle area: the scripts pass low = high nearly always (Camera.Focus.AddCircleArea(-62.8f, -62.8f, 0.83f)), with keep from 0 (pinned) to 1.
